senses.gloss:
तण्ड् तण्ड् (connected with तड्), cl. 1. A.
तण्डते, &c., to beat.
तण्ड तण्ड, अस्, m., N. of a man.

ताण्ड ताण्ड, अस्, m. (fr. तण्ड or तण्डा),
N. of an old sage; (अम्), n., N. of a Brāhmaṇa.

तण्डक तण्डक, अस्, अम्, m. n. complete per-
formance or preparation; decoration; the upright
post of a house; composition abounding in compound
words; (अस्), m. a juggler, a cheat; the trunk of a
tree; froth, foam; a wagtail; [cf. ताण्डक.]
ताण्डक, अम्, n., N. of a Brāhmaṇa.

तण्डि तण्डि, इस्, m., N. of a man; also of
a Ṛṣi in the Kṛta-yuga who saw and praised Śiva.

ताण्डि, इ, n., N. of a manual of the art of dancing;
the science of dancing.

तण्डिन् तण्डिन्, ई, m., N. of the author of
a work on prosody quoted by Piṅgala.

ताण्डिन्, ई, m., N. of a writer on prosody; (इनस्),
m. pl., N. of a Vedic school founded by a pupil of
Vaiśampāyana.
—ताण्डि-ब्राह्मण, अम्, n., N. of
a Brāhmaṇa belonging to this school.

तण्डु तण्डु, उस्, m., N. of one of Śiva's
door-keepers and one of the original teachers of the
arts of dancing and mimicry.

तण्डुरीण तण्डुरीण, अस्, m. one not a citizen,
a barbarian; a fool, a blockhead; the water in which
rice has been soaked or steeped.

तण्डुल तण्डुल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be
fr. तड्, cf. तण्ड्), grain after threshing and winnowing,
especially rice; rice used as a weight; (अस्, आ), m. f. a
vermifuge plant or its seed [cf. तण्डुलु, विडङ्ग];
(अस्), m. a pot-herb, a sort of amaranth, = तण्डुलीय;
(आ), f. a kind of plant, = ओदनाह्वया, ओदनिका,
महा-समङ्गा; a sort of Sida; (ई), f., N. of
several plants, = यव-तिक्ता, शशाण्डुली, तण्डुलीय.
—तण्डुल-कण, अस्, m. a grain of rice.
—तण्डुल-
देव, अस्, m., N. of a poet of Kaśmīra.
—तण्डुल-
फला, f. long pepper.
—तण्डुलाम्बु (˚ल-अम्˚),
उ, n. rice-water or gruel.
—तण्डुलोत्थ (˚ल-उत्˚),
अम्, n. or तण्डुलोदक (˚ल-उद्˚), अम्, n. water in
which rice has been boiled, rice-gruel.
—तण्डु-
लौघ (˚ल-ओघ), अस्, m. a prickly sort of bamboo,
Bambusa Spinosa; a heap of grain.

तण्डुलीक, अस्, m. a kind of pot-herb, Amaranthus
Polygonoides.

तण्डुलीय, अस्, m. a kind of pot-herb, Amaranthus
Polygonoides; a vermifuge plant [cf. विडङ्ग]; a
mineral, iron pyrites.

तण्डुलीयक, अस्, m. Amaranthus Polygonoides;
a vermifuge seed; [cf. विडङ्ग.]

तण्डुलु, उस्, m. a plant the seeds of which are
used as a vermifuge; [cf. विडङ्ग.]
तण्डुलेर, अस्, m. Amaranthus Polygonoides.

तण्डूलिकाश्रम तण्डूलिकाश्रम (˚क-आश्˚), अस्,
m., N. of a hermitage, Mahā-bh. Vana-parva 4084.

ताण्डव ताण्डव, अस्, अम्, m. n. dancing,
especially with violent gesticulation, and particularly
applied to the frantic dance of the god Śiva and his
votaries; (in prosody) a tribrach or foot of three
short syllables; a sort of grass, Saccharum Procerum.
—ताण्डव-तालिक, अस्, m. an epithet of Nandin
the door-keeper of Śiva.
—ताण्डव-प्रिय, अस्, m.
an epithet of Śiva (‘fond of the Tāṇḍava dance’).
—ताण्डव-ब्राह्मण, perhaps a wrong reading
for ताण्डक-ब्राह्मण.

ताण्डवित, अस्, आ, अम्, moving round in a wild
dance; dancing; fluttering; frowning.

ताण्ड्य, अस्, m., N. of a preceptor; (अम्), n., N.
of a Brāhmaṇa belonging to the Sāma-veda, to which
there is a commentary by Sāyaṇa.
ताण्ड्यायनी, f. a patronymic from Tāṇḍya.
